comments.value: I love how VRChat is laidout, its cozy and manages to look stunning while doing so. I would love to be able to customize my VRChat Home the way I want. PLEASE, I WANT THIS!

Ill agree with this, being able ti add a little personal touch to your login would be fantastic, maybe just a way to bind the world to you account and upload photos to it would still be better than nothing. Maybe a folder you can fill with pictures that picture frames around the room use?
I would totaly love it. So I say "yes" like john seed
Nice idea! I'll agree with this too... without further questions :-)

I must admit some way to modify it would be nice, indeed. Maybe something like that steam or oculus home where you have an inventory of stuff to spawn. Or they could just add it to the SDK ;-) ? Only the geometry and materials without all the infos or toys would me more than enough. That would give new people a playground for first babysteps like placing a mirror, add a trigger or how chairs or video panels work, without the hassle of creating the room first. Maybe it would even lure them into the sdk just to have the most beautiful home.

yeah, we'd like to do this too. just needs a little bit of a think and some work as there are components in it we'd like to retain that had future plans. These are scripted elements we'd need to package up somehow. We can also maybe just release a simple version with scripts removed.

@{58c6d558ff44e44ada717902|full_name}: I guess for now a simple version with all future planned scripts removed, would be really awesome and still give people a lot to play around with. Thank you guys for your work!

@{58c6d558ff44e44ada717902|full_name}: Oh my goodness i would be more than happy with the scripts removed just so i could get to work on it sooner! I really want to flesh it out way more with graphical improvements! I'm an aspiring technical artist and it would be awesome to have for testing stuff out!!
As of today, Home Kit is now available! https://docs.vrchat.com/docs/vrchat-kits

details:
I really love the new VR-Home feature and the room that came with it. But for me as a designer it's too plain and i want to decorate it as i like. Also the german community also loves the idea of decorating the VR-Home. I too think that it would make a good start for new people to get into World-Design.
So i wish that the VR-Home is provided as download, so everyone can create their own VR-Home.
title: Download the VR-Home
